about: The author gathers a catena of prophecies on the coming of Christ: Isaiah (9:6, 42:1, 35:3–6), David (Psalms 50, 118, 84, 87, 72), Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Habakkuk (3:3), Elijah, Joel and Solomon. Each is introduced by 'as so-and-so prophesied and said' and often closed with the marker ብሂል 'saying', that is, 'it means'. The theme is that God himself comes and lives among men, that the nations believe, and that Israel refuses.

sentences.l: And-concerning his-coming, hear how they-prophesied 1-1 (?) of-Adam, for-hearing (?): concerning his-coming prophesied Isaiah and-said, 'Son was-born for-us, child was-given for-us, authority written upon his-shoulder; he (is) God, strong-of judgment, king, great-of counsel (is) his-name';
sentences.i: And as for his coming, listen to how they prophesied — one by one (?), for the hearing of Adam's line (?). Concerning his coming Isaiah prophesied and said: 'A son was born for us; a child was given to us; authority is written upon his shoulder. He is God, strong in judgment, a king, great in counsel — such is his name.'
sentences.n: The quotation is Isaiah 9:6, with the titles run together. Read ተነበየ ኢሳይያስ ወይቤ as 'prophesied Isaiah and-said' (verb first, subject after); ወ- 'and', ለነ = ለ- 'to' + -ነ 'us'; ጽሑፍ is a passive participle 'written'; መትከፍቱ 'his shoulder' (መትከፍት + -ሁ, written -ቱ). ጽኑዐ ምኵናን, ዐቢየ ምክር are construct-like: 'strong-of judgment', 'great-of counsel'; ምኵናን 'judgment, authority' (?). The printed ፩፩ዘአዳም has two digit signs ፩ ፩ ('one, one' — not eleven, which would be ፲፩) fused to ዘአዳም; I read it 'one by one, of Adam' (?); kept as printed, and the clause is read loosely (?). ለሰሚዖት is ለ- + a verbal noun of ሰምዐ 'for hearing' (the ending -ዖት is unusual) (?).

And-again prophesied and-said Isaiah, 'Behold my-child whom I-chose, whom was-pleased my-soul upon-him, and-they-will-trust reckonings in-him';
sentences.i: And its interpretation says this plainly: the Son of God was born, he whose kingdom is written from before the world, and he is wiser than all — so it tells you. And again Isaiah prophesied and said: 'Behold my child, whom I chose, in whom my soul took pleasure; and in him the reckonings (?) will put their trust.'
sentences.n: ወትርጓሜሁ 'and-its-interpretation' (ወ- + noun + -ሁ). ወልደ is the construct 'son-of' before እግዚኣብሔር. ዘመንግሥቱ: ዘ- 'he whose' + 'kingdom-his'. ወይጠብብ 'and he is wise', እምነ 'more than'. ይብለከ 'it says to you' (-ከ 'to you'). The second quotation is Isaiah 42:1 (the chosen servant), then verse 4 (hope). ቊልዔየ 'my child, boy' (-የ 'my'); ዘኀረይኩ 'whom I chose' (1cs perfect); ዘሠምረት ነፍስየ 'in whom my soul was pleased' (ሠምረ + fem. subject ነፍስ). ወይትዌከሉ is a tä-stem of ወከለ 'to trust'. አሕሳብ is 'reckonings, thoughts'; the sense wants አሕዛብ 'nations' (cf. the next unit), so a scribal slip is likely (?), kept as printed.

sentences.i: And again this also shows us that the Spirit of God is Christ, the Word of the Father, who put on our flesh and was born for us; and the peoples of Rome and Ethiopia believed in him, and every other nation too; and to Israel, the people, he says to them. And again he prophesied and said: 'Many will follow you, coming behind you, bent in the loins and bound behind in chains, and they will pray to you and bow down to you, for you are God — and we did not know you.'
sentences.n: A long unit (45 words) with no ፤ inside, kept whole. ያሌብወነ: ya- (3ms imperfect) of the causative ʾa-stem 'make understand' + -ነ 'us'. መንፈሰ 'spirit of' stands in the accusative as the subject after ከመ 'that'; ቃለ 'word of' is in apposition to it (?). ዘለብሰ 'who put on' (ዘ- + perfect). ወለእስራኤልሰ: ወ- + ለ- + name + contrastive -ሰ 'as for Israel'. In the quotation: ይተልዉከ 'they follow you'; ቅኑታን 'bent, bowed' and እሱራን 'bound' are plural adjectives; ሐቌሆሙ 'their loins'; ድኅሪተ 'behind'. This resembles Isaiah 45:14 but is not an exact quotation (?). ወኢያእመርናከ 'and-not-we-knew-you' = 'we did not know you' (1cp perfect + -ከ); the author comments on it next.

sentences.i: And again he prophesied and said: 'God will come, and the nations will trust and will know' — and this also means: Christ came, and the Jews refused him, and the nations believed in him.
sentences.n: ይመጽእ 'he will come' (3ms imperfect, with future sense); ወይትዌከሉ ወያአምሩ 'and they will trust and will know' (3mp). አሕዛብ 'peoples, nations' (the Gentiles) set against አይሁድ 'the Jews'. No single verse is quoted; the sense is that of the prophets' hope of the nations (the author does not say which book). ብሂል closes the explanation.

sentences.i: And again he prophesied and said: 'Be strong, hands of the weak, and knees of the feeble; rejoice, you faint of heart, for God has come, who pays our debt and saves us; who opens the eyes of the blind, and makes the ears of the deaf hear, and makes the feet of the lame run, and makes the tongue of the mute speak' — so they read (?).
sentences.n: This is Isaiah 35:3–6 (the healings of the coming God), loosely rendered. Imperatives ጽንዑ 'be strong!', ተፈሥሑ 'rejoice!' (2mp); ዕንቡዛነ ልብ 'faint-ones of heart' (construct before ልብ). Note the causative ʾa-stem verbs ያሰምዕ 'makes hear', ያረውጽ 'makes run', ያነብብ 'makes speak', each followed by an object in the construct ('eyes-of', 'ear-of'). ዘይፈዲ 'who repays' (ዘ- + imperfect). ዕዳነ 'our debt' (-ነ). ይነቡ at the end is read 'they read / they recite' (?), pointing to the scripture just quoted.

sentences.i: And this also was said to those who went astray in bowing down to idols, and to those who are dead in sin, and to those whose heart is darkened and who do not know the one who created them.
sentences.n: ዘተብህለ 'what was said' (ዘ- + passive perfect of ብህለ); the Geʿez sets እለ straight after it, so the 'to' in my English (and the bracketed '(to)' above) is supplied, and 'concerning' is as possible (?). እለ is the plural relative 'those who'. ተስሕቱ is the Gt perfect 'they went astray'; በሰጊድ 'in bowing' (verbal noun); ለጣዖት 'to idols' (ለ- + noun). The person shifts inside the relative clauses (ልብክሙ 'your heart', ኢታአምሩ 'you do not know', ዘፈጠረክሙ 'who created you'), a normal Geʿez freedom; I give it in the third person in the English for smoothness (the Geʿez is second person plural).

sentences.i: And the blind saw, and the lame walked, and the deaf heard, and the mute spoke rightly, and, further, the dead rose — so it means. As David the prophet prophesied and said: 'God will come openly, and our God will not keep silent.' As Jeremiah prophesied and said: 'God will come down upon the earth and will walk about with men like us.' As Ezekiel the prophet prophesied and said: 'I will come, I, their God, and I will walk about in their midst, and they will know me, that I am their God.'
sentences.n: A long unit (48 words) with no ፤ to cut at, kept whole; it runs the three prophecies together, each introduced by በከመ ተነበየ 'as [so-and-so] prophesied'. The first half retells the healings in the perfect (ርእዩ, ሖሩ, ሰምዑ, ተናገሩ, ተንሥኡ) as accomplished fact. 'God will come and will not keep silent' is Psalm 50:3 (49:3 in the Greek numbering). The Jeremiah line, 'God will come down on earth and live among men', is not found in the Jeremiah we know; it resembles Baruch 3:38, which early Christian writers ascribed to Jeremiah (?). The Ezekiel line resembles the covenant promise 'I will be their God' (Ezekiel 37:27, Leviticus 26:12) but is not an exact quotation (?). Forms: ኢያረምም 'will not be silent' (3ms negative); ወያንሶሱ / ወኣንሶሱ 'he/I will walk about' (3ms and 1cs of the four-letter verb); ከማነ 'like us'; ወያአምሩኒ 'and they will know me' (-ኒ 'me'); ማእከሎሙ 'in their midst'; -ሰ and -ሂ are emphatic and 'also' enclitics.

sentences.i: As Elijah the prophet prophesied and said: 'In a new ordinance God will come to us.' As Joel the prophet prophesied and said: 'Emmanuel, the heavenly one, will come and will save his handiwork — [which he ... (?)] by his hand — from the hand of the Devil the oppressor and his deceiving demons.' And as David the prophet prophesied and said: 'The God of gods will appear in Zion.'
sentences.n: The words given to Elijah and to Joel do not match anything I can identify in those prophets; they are given as the text attributes them (?). አማኑኤል is Emmanuel ('God with us', as in Isaiah 7:14), here attributed to Joel as printed. ሥርዐት 'ordinance, order' and ሐዲስ 'new' (a hint at the 'new covenant'). ተግባሮ 'his work, handiwork' (ተግባር + -ኦ 'his'). The verb ዘለሐኰ is uncertain to me (?): I cannot fix its root or sense; 'which he [formed?] by his hand' is a guess from the context only — I leave it marked and the English incomplete. ተዐጋሊ 'oppressor'; መስሕታን 'deceivers' (plural). The last quotation is Psalm 84:7 (83:8 in the Greek numbering): 'the God of gods will be seen in Zion'. ያስተርኢ is the ʾastä-stem 'appears, is made manifest'; አምላከ አማልክት is a construct 'God of gods'; በጽዮን 'in Zion'.

sentences.l: And-again he-said, 'Our-mother Zion, will-say (a) man, and-a-man was-born in-her, and-he (the) Most-High founded-her'; and-as prophesied Solomon, his-son, and-said, 'Truly will-be God with men and-will-walk-about upon earth'; and-as prophesied his-father David and-said, 'He-will-descend like dew upon (the) fleece and-like (the) drop which-drips upon earth, and-will-spring righteousness in-his-days'.
sentences.i: And again he said: 'Our mother Zion,' a man will say, 'and a man was born in her, and he, the Most High, founded her.' And as Solomon, his son, prophesied and said: 'Truly God will be with men and will walk about upon the earth.' And as his father David prophesied and said: 'He will come down like dew upon the fleece, and like the drop that drips upon the earth, and righteousness will spring up in his days.'
sentences.n: The first quotation is Psalm 87:5 (86:5 in the Greek numbering); the rest matches Solomon's prayer in 1 Kings 8:27 loosely (God dwelling with men on earth), and Psalm 72:6–7 (71:6–7 in the Greek numbering) for the dew and the righteousness that flourishes. Slips kept as printed: ወብእ ሲ is two pieces for ወብእሲ 'and a man'; ሰሎሞን ወልዲ has ወልዲ for ወልደ or ወልዱ (the -ዲ is read 'his', i.e. David's son) (?). Forms: እምነ ጽዮን 'our mother Zion' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'; Zion is feminine, and the suffix of ሣረራ 'founded her' is feminine too); ይብል ሰብእ 'a man will say'. ዘያንጠበጥብ 'which drips'; ፀምር 'wool, fleece'; ይሠርጽ 'will spring up, bud'; በመዋዕሊሁ 'in his days'. The unit is long (44 words) and has no ፤ to cut at.

glossary.ነፍስየ: ነፍስ — my soul, my life (noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.አሕሳብ: ሐሳብ — reckonings, thoughts (noun, plural አሕሳብ; here subject, a loose rendering of 'nations') (?)
glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አዕይንተ: ዐይን — eyes (plural አዕይንት, accusative) · construct 'eyes of' (አዕይንተ ዕዉራኒሆሙ 'the eyes of their blind', ch. 95)
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ) · nominative, subject or apposition (ኀተምዋ አይሁድ 'the Jews sealed it'; ዕዉራነ ልብ አይሁድ 'the Jews, blind of heart')
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.ኢያረምም: አረመመ — he will not be silent (ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, r-m-m)
glossary.እመጽእ: መጽአ — I will come (1cs imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምቴማን: ቴማን — from Teman (እም- 'from' + proper name; also 'south')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel') · 'above' in ተሰብሐ እምነ ኵሎሙ 'was praised above (?) all of them', or possibly the agent 'by' (?) · partitive 'of, from among' (እምነ ፸ አርድእት 'of the seventy disciples')
glossary.እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምደብረ: ደብር — from the mountain of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct 'mountain of')
glossary.እሱራን: እሱር — bound (passive adjective, plural እሱራን, used of hearts: 'bound')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እደው: እድ — hands (noun, fem., plural እደው; vocative)
glossary.እግረ: እግር — feet, foot (noun, fem.; accusative/construct 'feet of')
glossary.እግዚኣብሔርሰ: እግዚአብሔር — God, indeed (noun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ; spelled -ኣ-)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ወለእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and for Israel indeed (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወርእዩ: ርእየ — and they saw (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ወሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — and they heard (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — and they hanged him, crucified him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወቅዱስኒ: ቅዱስ — and the Holy One also (ወ- + adjective used as noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወበእንተሰ: በእንተ — and concerning indeed (ወ- + በእንተ + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወባዕድኒ: ባዕድ — and another also, furthermore (ወ- + adjective/noun 'other' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወብረከ: ብርክ — and knees of (ወ- + noun, plural ብረክ, construct state)
glossary.ወብእ: ብእሲ — and a man (ወ- + first half of ብእሲ, printed apart from its ending ሲ)
glossary.ወተናገሩ: ተናገረ — and they spoke (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-g-r)
glossary.ወተወልደ: ተወልደ — and was born (ወ- + 3m sg passive perfect)
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem) · and rejoice! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትርጓሜሁ: ትርጓሜ — and its interpretation (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ወአምላክነሂ: አምላክ — and our God also (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወአምኑ: አምነ — and they believed (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወአበዩ: አበየ — and they refused (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y)
glossary.ወአበይዎ: አበየ — and they refused him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-b-y + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአጋንንቲሁ: ጋኔን — and his demons (ወ- + plural አጋንንት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወኢታአምሩ: አእመረ — and you do not know (ወ- + ኢ- negative + 2mp imperfect, ʾa-stem, ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ወኢያእመርናከ: አእመረ — and we did not know you (ወ- + ኢ- negative + 1cp perfect, ʾa-stem, ʿ-m-r, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወኢያእመርናከሰ: አእመረ — and we did not know you, indeed (ወ- + ኢ- + 1cp perfect, ʾa-stem, + -ከ '2ms you' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወኣንሶሱ: ነሶሰወ — and I walk about (ወ- + 1cs imperfect of the four-radical verb; written ኣንሶሱ, form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእምአህጉረ: ሀገር — and from the cities of (ወ- + እም- 'from' + plural አህጉር, construct state)
glossary.ወእሱራን: እሱር — and bound ones, captives (ወ- + adjective, plural እሱራን, passive of አሰረ)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘንተኒ: ዝንቱ — and this also (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወያረውጽ: አሮጸ — and he makes run (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative ʾa-stem of ሮጸ, r-w-ṣ)
glossary.ወያሰምዕ: አሰምዐ — and he makes hear (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative ʾa-stem of ሰምዐ, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወያነብብ: አነበበ — and he makes speak (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative ʾa-stem of ነበበ, n-b-b)
glossary.ወያንሶሱ: ነሶሰወ — and he walks about, will walk about (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, quadriliteral n-s-s-w)
glossary.ወያአምሩ: አእመረ — and they will know (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, ʾa-stem, ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ወያአምሩኒ: አእመረ — and they will know me (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, ʾa-stem, + -ኒ '1cs me', object suffix)
glossary.ወያድኅነነ: አድኀነ — and he saves us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, d-ḫ-n, + -ነ '1cp us'; verb አድኀነ 'save')
glossary.ወያድኅን: አድኀነ — and he saves (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem)
glossary.ወይሠርጽ: ሠርጸ — and it springs up, sprouts (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ś-r-ṣ)
glossary.ወይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — and they bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
glossary.ወይትዌከሉ: ተወከለ — and they will trust (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem, w-k-l)
glossary.ወይከሥት: ከሠተ — and he opens (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይጠብብ: ጠበበ — and he is wise (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ወይጼልዩ: ጸለየ — and they pray (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ወፈላስያን: ፈላሲ — and ascetics, hermits (ወ- + plural ፈላስያን; ፈላሲ 'one who goes into exile, wanderer')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዕንቡዛነ: ዕንቡዝ — faint, timid (adjective, plural accusative/vocative, construct before ልብ: 'faint of heart')
glossary.ዕዉራን: ዕዉር — blind (adjective, plural ዕዉራን, used as a noun, subject)
glossary.ዕውራን: ዕዉር — blind (adjective, plural ዕዉራን, used as a noun; construct 'of blind')
glossary.ዘለሐኰ: ለሐኰ — (?) root and sense not established; the context (his work, by his hand) suggests 'formed, moulded', a guess from context only (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect) (?)
glossary.ዘለብሰ: ለብሰ — who put on (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘመንግሥቱ: መንግሥት — whose kingdom (ዘ- relative + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his', joined to final -ት as -ቱ)
glossary.ዘሠምረት: ሠምረ — in whom (it) was pleased (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G, ś-m-r; subject ነፍስ fem.)
glossary.ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ዘኀረይኩ: ኀረየ — whom I chose (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame')

glossary.ዘይፈዲ: ፈደየ — who pays, repays (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, f-d-y)
glossary.ዘፈጠረክሙ: ፈጠረ — who created you (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ያሌብወነ: አለበወ — he makes us understand (3ms imperfect, causative ʾa-stem of ለበወ, l-b-w, + -ነ '1cp us'; the ሌ- spelling is unexplained) (?)
glossary.ያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — he/it appears, is manifest (3ms imperfect, ʾastä-stem)

glossary.ይብለከ: ብህለ — he/it says to you (3ms imperfect, G, defective verb b-h-l, + -ከ 'to you')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብሎሙ: ብህለ — he says to them (3ms imperfect, G, defective b-h-l, + -ሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ይተልዉከ: ተለወ — they will follow you (3mp imperfect/subjunctive, G, t-l-w, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ይነቡ: ነበበ — they read, speak (3mp imperfect/jussive, G, n-b-b; contracted spelling for ይነብቡ) (?)
glossary.ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ዲቤሁ: ዲበ — upon him, upon it (preposition, stem ዲቤ- + -ሁ '3ms')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድልው: ድልው — fitting, ready, due (adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.ድኅሪተ: ድኅሪት — behind, backward (fem. noun ድኅሪት 'rear', adverbial accusative) (?)
glossary.ድኅሬከ: ድኅሬ — behind you, after you (preposition/noun ድኅሬ- + -ከ '2ms')
glossary.ድኩማን: ድኩም — weak (adjective, plural ድኩማን, used as a noun: 'of the weak')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ገዳማዊ: ገዳማዊ — monk, hermit, one of the wilderness (relational adjective in -ዊ from ገዳም 'wilderness', used as a noun; here the stem before plural -ያን)
glossary.ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
glossary.ጽሙማን: ጽሙም — deaf (adjective, plural ጽሙማን, used as a noun)
glossary.ጽንዑ: ጸንዐ — be strong! (2mp imperative, G, ṣ-n-ʿ; spelled ጽንዑ)
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፅቡሳን: ጽቡስ — feeble, frail (adjective, plural ጽቡሳን, used as a noun; spelled ፅ-) (?)
glossary.ፋራን: ፋራን — Paran (proper name; ደብረ ፋራን 'Mount Paran')
glossary.፩፩ዘአዳም: አዳም — spoken አሐዱ አሐዱ (äḥadu äḥadu) 'one, one' (two digit signs ፩ ፩, not 'eleven', which would be ፲፩) + ዘ- 'of' + Adam; the numeral is fused to ዘአዳም, read doubtfully 'one by one, of Adam' (?)
glossary.፻፮: ምእት — spoken ምእት ወስድስቱ (məʾət wä-sədsətu) 'one hundred and six' (numeral, chapter number ፻፮ = 100 + 6)
